sql: SELECT "visit"."Museum_ID" AS k, (CAST("visit"."Total_spent" AS REAL) / "visit"."Num_of_Ticket") AS m1 FROM "visit" WHERE (CAST("visit"."Total_spent" AS REAL) / "visit"."Num_of_Ticket") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: visit.total amount spent per number of tickets bought
why: total amount spent / number of tickets bought: the catalogue declares total amount spent a rate over number of tickets bought
rank visit rows by total amount spent per number of tickets bought
